policy: Published/classical unformalized results may remain precise explicit inputs under the resumed user instruction. All own derivations are required and are not reclassified as external. Inputs are proposition parameters, never custom axiom declarations. This registry is not an axiom audit or a validation certificate.

lean_declarations.name: ClassicalCroftonLaw
lean_declarations.statement:
def ClassicalCroftonLaw : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : ℕ), 2 ≤ m → ∀ (L : ℝ), 0 < L → ∀ (ψ : ℝ → Source.Space m),
    AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval ψ 0 L → (∀ s ∈ Icc 0 L, ‖ψ s‖ = 1) →
      (∫⁻ D, ((transverseZeros ψ L D).encard : ℝ≥0∞) ∂standardGaussian m) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (1 / Real.pi) * sphericalLength ψ L ∧
      ∀ᵐ D ∂standardGaussian m, (transverseZeros ψ L D).Finite

lean_declarations.name: GaussianRegressionInput
lean_declarations.statement:
def GaussianRegressionInput : Prop :=
  ∀ (q K : ℕ) (m : GaussianUnit q) (z : Fin q → ℝ),
    (∀ j i, MemLp (fun ω : GaussianUnit.Sample q K => m.residuals z ω j i) 2 (m.sampleLaw K)) ∧
    (∀ j i, (∫ ω : GaussianUnit.Sample q K, m.residuals z ω j i ∂m.sampleLaw K) = 0) ∧
    (∀ j i k, (∫ ω : GaussianUnit.Sample q K,
        m.residuals z ω j i * m.residuals z ω j k ∂m.sampleLaw K) =
      m.covariance i k - (m.covariance *ᵥ z) i * (m.covariance *ᵥ z) k / m.scoreVariance z) ∧
    IndepFun (m.scores (K := K) z) (m.residuals (K := K) z) (m.sampleLaw K)

lean_declarations.name: ArclengthFactorizationInput
lean_declarations.statement:
def ArclengthFactorizationInput : Prop :=
  ∀ (d : ℕ), 0 < d → ∀ (η : ℝ → Space d) (L : ℝ), 0 ≤ L →
    ContinuousOn η (Icc 0 L) → eVariationOn η (Icc 0 L) ≠ ∞ →
    ∃ (x u : ℝ → Space d) (σ : ℝ → ℝ),
      LipschitzWith 1 x ∧ Measurable u ∧ (∀ s, ‖u s‖=1) ∧
      (∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Icc 0 (eVariationOn η (Icc 0 L)).toReal), HasDerivAt x (u s) s) ∧
      ContinuousOn σ (Icc 0 L) ∧ MonotoneOn σ (Icc 0 L) ∧
      σ '' Icc 0 L = Icc 0 (eVariationOn η (Icc 0 L)).toReal ∧
      EqOn η (x ∘ σ) (Icc 0 L)

lean_declarations.name: FiniteMaxACCalculusInput
lean_declarations.statement:
def FiniteMaxACCalculusInput : Prop :=
  ∀ (q : ℕ) (K : Fin q → ℕ) (hK : ∀ r, 0 < K r) (T : ℝ)
    (f a : (r : Fin q) → Fin (K r) → ℝ → ℝ)
    (J : (s : ℝ) → (r : Fin q) → Fin (K r)),
    (∀ r j, AbsolutelyContinuousOnInterval (f r j) 0 T) →
    (∀ r j, ∀ᵐ s ∂volume.restrict (Icc 0 T), HasDerivAt (f r j) (a r j s) s) →
    (∀ s r j, f r j s ≤ f r (J s r) s) →
    eVariationOn (fun s => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun r => finiteSup (hK r) (fun j => f r j s)))
      (Icc 0 T) =
      ∫⁻ s in Icc 0 T, ENNReal.ofReal ‖WithLp.toLp 2 (fun r => a r (J s r) s)‖
